how-numa-products-are-made.title: How Numa Nutrition products are made
how-numa-products-are-made.excerpt: Modern manufacturing, natural ingredients and strict quality control at every stage
how-numa-products-are-made.lead: Every NUMA Nutrition product travels a long way — from raw material selection to the final laboratory check. Here is how manufacturing works and why quality control starts long before bottling.

sections.heading: Raw material selection
sections.text: Each formula is built on natural components: plant extracts, honey, seaweed, vitamins and minerals. Suppliers pass a mandatory review and every batch of raw material comes with documents on origin and safety.

sections.heading: Modern manufacturing
sections.text: Production is organised in line with the international GMP and ISO 22000:2018 standards. The technological lines preserve the properties of active substances, while a closed bottling cycle prevents any contact with the outside environment.

sections.heading: Quality control at every stage
sections.text: Products pass laboratory control at the input, in process and at the output. We check microbiological indicators, the content of active substances, formula stability and packaging tightness. No batch goes on sale without a confirmed protocol.

sections.heading: Transparency for the customer
sections.text: We state the real formula, dosages and shelf life. Every product comes with usage recommendations, and company specialists are always ready to answer questions and help build a programme.

how-numa-products-are-made.outro: This approach lets us speak about quality not as a promise, but as a process that can be verified.

scientific-approach.title: The scientific approach — the foundation of the NUMA Family philosophy
scientific-approach.excerpt: Products are created on the basis of scientific research and the recommendations of leading specialists
scientific-approach.lead: In its work NUMA Family relies not only on natural ingredients and modern technology, but also on a scientific approach. One of the experts whose professional experience is connected with the development of hygiene, nutrition and children's health is Guli Islamovna Shaykhova.

sections.heading: Who is Guli Islamovna Shaykhova?
sections.text: Guli Islamovna Shaykhova is an Uzbek scientist, Doctor of Medical Sciences and professor. She has made a significant contribution to the development of hygiene, in particular in the field of the hygiene of children, adolescents and nutrition.

sections.heading: Professional work
sections.text: Guli Islamovna was born in 1951. She works at the department of Hygiene of Children, Adolescents and Nutrition at the Tashkent Medical Academy. Her main specialisation is connected with hygiene, children's health and questions of rational nutrition.

sections.heading: Scientific work and achievements
sections.text: More than 650 scientific and popular-science works have been published, around 100 of them in specialised scientific journals. She is the author of textbooks, monographs and methodological manuals, and has supervised a large number of candidates and doctors of science.

sections.heading: Contribution to healthy nutrition
sections.text: Guli Islamovna took part in developing national programmes and legislative acts on nutrient deficiency and iodine insufficiency. Her experience underlines the importance of a scientific approach to health, nutrition and prevention.

scientific-approach.outro: It is exactly this foundation that lets NUMA Family create products trusted by families across Uzbekistan.

international-recognition.title: International recognition of quality
international-recognition.excerpt: NUMA Nutrition products have been recognised with international awards and quality certificates
international-recognition.lead: Over recent years NUMA Nutrition products have gained recognition on international stages: from industry exhibitions to specialised innovation competitions.

sections.heading: Awards and competitions
sections.text: The company's products have been awarded gold medals at international invention and innovation competitions, and have received national industry awards for quality and contribution to the development of manufacturing.

sections.heading: International certificates
sections.text: Production is certified to the ISO 22000:2018 and GMP standards, and the products are confirmed by HALAL, USDA Organic certificates and the European organic EURO-LEAF mark.

sections.heading: What this means for the customer
sections.text: A certificate is not only a document. It means regular audits, a reproducible formula and a guarantee that the product bought today will not differ from the one bought a year from now.

international-recognition.outro: We continue to work on expanding the list of international quality confirmations.

normal-hemoglobin-level.title: How to maintain a normal haemoglobin level
normal-hemoglobin-level.excerpt: An iron deficiency can affect wellbeing and performance. Learn how to maintain a normal haemoglobin level naturally
normal-hemoglobin-level.lead: Fatigue, pale skin, reduced concentration — all of this can be linked to an iron deficiency. Let us look at what to pay attention to and how to support the body.

sections.heading: Why the haemoglobin level matters
sections.text: Haemoglobin carries oxygen from the lungs to the tissues. When its level drops, the body receives less oxygen — hence the fatigue and the reduced stamina and performance.

sections.heading: Nutrition comes first
sections.text: The diet should include sources of iron: meat, liver, legumes, buckwheat and green leafy vegetables. Vitamin C improves iron absorption, while strong tea and coffee right after a meal reduce it.

sections.heading: Additional support
sections.text: Natural syrups such as Hemoglobin+ contain components that support blood formation and help maintain a normal haemoglobin level as part of a balanced lifestyle.

sections.heading: When to see a specialist
sections.text: If fatigue persists for several weeks, take a complete blood count and discuss the results with a doctor. Food and supplements do not replace medical care.

normal-hemoglobin-level.outro: Consistency and attention to how you feel work better than one-off measures.

expanding-geography.title: NUMA Family expands its geography
expanding-geography.excerpt: The company is strengthening international cooperation and continues to grow its presence in foreign markets
expanding-geography.lead: NUMA Family is steadily moving beyond Uzbekistan: new distribution directions are opening and the number of official partners keeps growing.

sections.heading: New markets
sections.text: The company is developing cooperation with Central Asia, the Middle East and the CIS. In each region the products pass local registration and packaging adaptation to market requirements.

sections.heading: Partner network
sections.text: Today more than 500 official partners work with the company. Partners receive product training, marketing support and direct access to company specialists.

sections.heading: Development plans
sections.text: The nearest plans include expanding the range for children's and family health, as well as launching new diagnostic formats within the NUMA Diagnostics direction.

expanding-geography.outro: We believe that every family should have access to quality natural nutrition.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes what data NUMA Nutrition collects when you use the site and how we process it.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.text: We only collect data you provide voluntarily: name, phone number, city and delivery address when placing an order, and the text of your message when requesting a consultation.

sections.heading: How we use the data
sections.text: The data is used solely to process orders, deliver products and contact you about your request. We do not use it for marketing campaigns without your consent.

sections.heading: Sharing with third parties
sections.text: We never sell or share your personal data with third parties, except delivery services and payment providers to the extent required to fulfil an order.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.text: The site uses technical cookies required for the cart to work and to remember the selected language. You can disable them in your browser settings.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.text: You may request access to your data, its correction or deletion. Write to info@numanutrition.uz to do so.
